claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.statement: Canonical profile name is Blue Termite.
claims.verification_rationale: The name is corpus-backed but lacks an independent canonical authority.

claims.subject: threat-cluster
claims.statement: Blue Termite is classified as threat-cluster.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=none; actor type is audited independently of geography.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Blue Termite was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.
